_about: Channel rules, evaluated top to bottom; the first match sets the label. confirmed=true only where a primary source documents that this signal value marks the channel. As of 2026-10-02 no Shopify page documents the attribution, app, publication or sourceName values that orders from Shopify's AI channels carry, so every rule that reads those fields is unconfirmed. Replace the patterns with the values seen on the store's real orders.
_direct_checkout_note: When a rule says checkout=direct but the order shows a storefront session (landing_site, captured cart attributes or a customer-journey visit), the order is treated as store checkout. Shopify sends buyers outside the direct-checkout countries to the online store instead.

rules.status: unconfirmed: verify on the store's real orders before trusting the label
rules.basis: Shopify says AI-channel orders show in the admin with channel or referrer attribution, and that Order.attribution, Order.app and Order.publication identify the order source. No Shopify page shows the value a Google AI Mode or Gemini order carries. The pattern follows the channel name in Shopify Help ('Google AI Mode and Gemini'); a bare 'google' is avoided so Google & YouTube channel orders are not swept in.

rules.basis: Shopify Help: ChatGPT has no direct checkout; buyers finish on the store's own checkout. Whether Shopify then writes a ChatGPT value into Order.attribution, app, publication or sourceName is not documented.
OpenAI appends its click reference oppref to ChatGPT ad landing URLs; the pixel stores it in the __oppref cookie.

OpenAI: ChatGPT automatically includes utm_source=chatgpt.com in referral URLs. Documented for ChatGPT search referrals; whether shopping click-outs always carry it is not documented, so its absence does not rule ChatGPT out.
